_comment: PAIP2020 demo slides. Derived assets (web-display Deep Zoom, Whole Tumor Area GT, nucleus overlays) are hosted in Jae-Hoon-Jeong/projectpage_essets projects/sena_nbe/v2/paip/ (PROVENANCE.md there). Overlay and GT coordinates are native level-0 pixels (native_size); the viewer scales them to the displayed DZI. CMU fallback config: data/slides_cmu.json (?demo=cmu).
